profile.headline: Technical Leader - Software Engineering at Cisco
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary:
Over the last 18+ years, I've developed a broad and deep set of skills working with some of
the industries best, gaining valuable exposure to cutting-edge technology, best practices,
and standards. Working closely with teams of experts in UI and UX design, S.E.O, Analytics, API infrastructure, Software Development, and Project Planning, I have acquired a wealth of knowledge in many different languages and disciplines. Among those areas and others mentioned below, I’m able to create dynamic and engaging user-friendly Web Apps using the industry's latest browser technologies, as well as addressing the needs of
alternative platforms such as mobile devices.

Outside of the office, I like to attend conferences such as ‘NG-Conf, and 'An Event Apart', as
well as continuing my education by reading up on article's and tutorial's, taking online
classes, and monitoring industry trends to identify and successfully incorporate relevant
emerging technologies and best practices into my daily work.

HTML5 & CSS3:
Vast knowledge in web design, web standards, UI design, web trends, accessibility, SEO,
and more. Some experience using frameworks such as Bootstrap3+, BluePrint, and
Normalize as well as CSS3 extensions like SCSS/SASS and LESS. Comprehensive
experience with integrating front-end code with 3rd party platforms, mixing in and
building upon legacy code, as well as refactoring and cleaning up existing mark-up & assets
for optimized performance. Able to create, as well as transition existing sites into adaptive/
responsive designs. Effectively utilize best practices, and keep deliverables organized and
maintainable for scalability, debugging, and re-use. Huge advocate towards lean, clean, and
organized front-end code.

JavaScript​:
Experienced in creating complex JavaScript controls and interactions to enhance the UI for
a more intuitive and productive user experience, leveraging the use of AJAX and PHP where
needed. Working knowledge in intergrading plug-ins & widgets as well as creating and/or
customizing when needed.

Angular & RxJS:
In-depth knowledge and experience building a range of Angular applications, from small
self sustained single responsibility components, to large scale highly visible P1 application
with complex routing procedures and multiple modules. Leverage RxJS streams,
observables and behavior subjects to manage in memory objects and promises, as well as
improve data consumption and communication by introducing a more declarative
approach to collecting, composing, and caching data via the store/state concept – enhanced
by RxJS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Architect  | Employee Experience
Software Engineer & Technical Leader | Digital Enterprise Solutions
positions.description:
Called on to lead the ideation, design, and implementation of multiple business-critical back-office applications used by Cisco sellers and partners. Creator and co-maintainer of OneUX, a custom-built in-house suite of cross-functional front-end solutions leveraged by over 20+ IT applications.
 
In addition to the above, my role involves a balance of hands-on software development, UX research and UI design, project planning, engaging and influencing stakeholders, socializing best practices, consulting across multiple engineering teams, and mentoring college interns, new grads, and anyone eager to learn more about front-end development.
 
• Received 28 Connected Recognition Awards 
• Presented Digital Customer Listing Ironman Award - “In recognition of outstanding performance in innovation, demonstrating courage to make progress developing skills and capabilities necessary for tomorrow.”

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: Work closely with UI Director architecting, designing and developing user-first & design-centric AngularJS web apps, which consume first and third party API services providing the necessary tools for users to create impactful advertisement campaigns to meet quality lead generation goals.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: Responsibilities include front-end development in support of consumer and small business web-based initiatives. Creation of pixel perfect, fully functional, standards compliant, cross-browser/platform — static and dynamic pages with heavy use of hand written HTML, CSS, CSS3, Javascript, AJAX, JSON, and jQuery. Developing single page web applications and adaptive/responsive development in support of mobile devices. Key role in maintenance, site performance, UI, and SEO enhancements. Ongoing collaboration with UX, design, and analytics teams to implement, maintain and improve analytics tracking, and user experience  across store.sony.com.

positions.title: Web Content Specialist
positions.description: Performed HTML and CSS updates across store.sony.com. Managed all content development for VAIO Laptops & Desktop category. Developed and maintained online content and promotional campaigns, including: static pages, product content, banners, images, configurable products and other VAIO configure-to-order specific promotions and seasonal product launches. Leveraged trouble shooting skills to provide solution to system issues relating to order processing & configurable products. Worked closely with multiple departments within Sony Electronics Inc.

positions.title: UX Design & Front-End Developer
positions.description: Responsible for U.I (User Interface) design and front-end web development, incorporating marketing requirements into page design and layout, perform U.T (User Test) testing, the creation of wire frames/flow charts as well as clickable HTML prototypes. Worked in conjunction with other team members to define I.A (Information Architecture) flow/hierarchy as well as track analytical data.

honors.title: Cisco Digital Customer Listening - Ironman Award
honors.description: In recognition of outstanding performance in innovation, demonstrating courage to make progress, developing skills and capabilities necessary for tomorrow.
honors.issuer: Issued by Shaw-Jen Chang - VP. Information Technology at Cisco · Apr 2018

projects.title: Cisco Forecasting
projects.description: Next Generation Forecasting is a Cisco application which allows sellers to view their opportunity pipeline and manage judge of the forecast they roll up to finance.  This Sales IT program is built to enable the following business outcome.  Enable a forecasting solution that will Manage judge against accountability metrics, have the ability to roll up notes for context at opportunity or forecast level, can drill down visibility  to opportunities and the annuity stream, and be fully automated to reflect focus on recurring revenue growth and productivity gains.

projects.title: Sony eCommerce Platform Transformation
projects.description: Launched the new Sony eCommerce Platform from IBM WCS to the eBay (GSI) Platform.  This re-platform involved many parts including the gathering and analysis of business requirements against functionality that is provided out of the box versus requires a customization.  Content migration and 3rd party application integration, re-design of site creative, new business process creation and documentation, and training of all team members on the new content creation and web development systems.  Post launch we have continued to refine our processes and focus on improving site performance and key revenue generating customizations.
